integrity: The proof is analytic; the bundled program provides independently implemented exact-rational checks of representative algebra and a strict endpoint-tie certificate. No empirical data, exhaustive search theorem, independent validation or authorship is asserted.
limitations: Only two patches, deterministic exactly complementary period-two fecundity, uniform migration propensity, migration survival constant, density-independent asymptotic growth; does not imply any ESS or stochastic persistence result. Full texts of some adjacent life-cycle studies were unavailable, so equivalent prior coverage is a bibliographic risk.
title: An exact all-or-nothing dispersal transition under alternating habitat quality and migration mortality
